---
title: "Data Used"
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go

from _dashboard_utils import load_market_data_summary

market_data = load_market_data_summary()
```

## Row {height="45%"}

```{python}
#| title: "Instrument Coverage"
coverage = market_data.copy()
coverage["start_timestamp"] = pd.to_datetime(coverage["start_timestamp"])
coverage["end_timestamp"] = pd.to_datetime(coverage["end_timestamp"])

fig = px.timeline(
    coverage,
    x_start="start_timestamp",
    x_end="end_timestamp",
    y="symbol",
    color="asset_class",
)
fig.update_yaxes(autorange="reversed", title="")
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10))
fig.show()
```

```{python}
#| title: "Data Quality Flags per Instrument"
flags = market_data.melt(
    id_vars="symbol",
    value_vars=["extreme_return_count", "extreme_range_count", "unexpected_gap_count"],
    var_name="flag",
    value_name="count",
)

fig = px.bar(flags, x="symbol", y="count", color="flag", barmode="group")
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10), legend_title_text="")
fig.show()
```

## Row {height="45%"}

```{python}
#| title: "Market Data Summary"
table_columns = [
    "symbol",
    "asset_class",
    "currency",
    "exchange",
    "row_count",
    "start_timestamp",
    "end_timestamp",
    "largest_time_gap_minutes",
]
display_data = market_data[table_columns]

fig = go.Figure(
    go.Table(
        header=dict(values=list(display_data.columns), align="left"),
        cells=dict(
            values=[display_data[column] for column in display_data.columns],
            align="left",
        ),
    )
)
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=0, b=0))
fig.show()
```
